messages:
anya: Quick async — dropping the canonicalization + batching checklist I promised. Kernel change K-321 touches prefetch order and KV eviction heuristics. Need owners and any gating deps.
ryan: I can own the kernel patch (K-321). ETA Wed EOD.
jess: I will take batcher integration & perf CI. Can you drop the perf harness link? @anya
anya: Perf harness: https://go/internal/perf/harness. CI job name: `perf-kernel-bench`. Target: median latency < 200ms for our microbench.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary window tentatively scheduled 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC (48h window) — will update after gating.
tony: SRE question — are we comfortable with eviction threshold delta = 0.15 by default? This affects hotpath memory.
ryan: I can run sweeps with delta=0.10/0.15/0.20 today and post the microresults.
sam: Heads-up: routing team needs a tiny API contract change (mirror header for KV hints). @anya this blocks canary unless mirrored.
anya: Noted. eng-platform will need a rollout flag. @maria can you add one?
maria: I can add `rollout.kernel_canonicalization` feature flag and a short-lived toggle. Should be ready Tue morning.
jess: I'll queue the CR for batching changes: GH #8421 — tagging @ryan for kernel review.
ryan: On it, will review today and leave comments inline.
anya: Short checklist (canonical):
```
1) Kernel patch merged (K-321) — owner: ryan
2) Batcher integration tests green — owner: jess
3) Perf benchmarks (perf-kernel-bench) median < 200ms, p99 regressions < 5% — owners: jess/ryan
4) SRE signoff (runbook + alerts) — owner: tony
5) Feature flag staged in eng-platform — owner: maria
6) Mirror routing header change deployed — owner: sam
7) Canary scheduled & monitored (48h) — deploy-bot
```
jess: Adding regression thresholds: p99 increase < 5% and p50 shouldn't degrade > 10% (measured on perf-harness baseline).
deploy-bot: SRE policy: rollback triggers = error rate > 0.5% OR latency p95 > configured threshold. Canary auto-alerts enabled.
anya: Owners summary: kernel=ryan, batcher=jess, platform=maria, routing=sam, SRE=tony. Reply here if you need different assignment.
tony: SRE ack — I'll own the runbook + monitors.
sam: I will draft the routing proto change and post a link. Need a quick review from @anya for compatibility.
anya: Pushed proto draft: https://github.com/redwood/kernels/pull/99 — please review.
jess: CR link for batching: https://github.com/redwood/batcher/pull/8421 — tagging reviewers now.
ryan: Will post kernel perf microresults by EOD.
anya: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a status ping Tue morning. :thumbsup:
